dataset_name: Indore Hospitals, Clinics and Healthcare Centres Directory
data_quality_notice: SYNTHETIC TEST FILE: 'synthetic_test_data' blocks are fabricated. Working dataset based on user-supplied information. Source URLs and source fields have been removed as requested. Details have not been independently verified. Reported services are not confirmed capabilities. Unknown values must not be treated as available or unavailable. Enriched values (where present) come from public web pages and are still not independently verified; bed counts and service availability can change.

field_conventions.null: Information not supplied or not known; do not interpret as false.
field_conventions.reported_fields: Reported in the supplied notes, not necessarily independently verified.
field_conventions.enrichment: Entries enriched on 2026-10-09 from publicly available web pages (hospital websites, accreditation and insurer/aggregator listings). Only values found in sources were filled; everything else remains null/unknown. Third-party listings can be outdated or conflict with each other.
field_conventions.synthetic_test_data: Randomly generated (seed 42) demo values for small clinics/health centres, with deliberate outliers. NOT real; never use for patient referral or any real decision.
field_conventions.synthetic_facilities: Facility values with status 'synthetic_test_data' are randomly generated demo values replacing unknowns. Real/reported values keep their original status. Never use for real decisions.

referral_safety.rule: Do not rank or route patients based only on this dataset. Verify current service availability, acceptance, operating hours, clinician capability, and facility capacity before referral.
referral_safety.emergency_instruction: For suspected life-threatening emergencies, use local emergency services and clinician judgment; do not delay care while relying on this directory.
